## Technology & Infrastructure

- Language and runtime: TypeScript 5.6 strict, Bun 1.4 for tests and scripts, Node 20 in production images (Node 22 upgrade tracked in docs/ops/node-upgrade.md and blocked on the pdfkit fork).
- HTTP: Fastify 5. Storage: Postgres 16 through a small query layer in `src/store/`.
- Deployment: container images built in CI, rolled out by the platform team's pipeline. Tenant-level feature flags live in `src/flags/` and are read per request.

## Architecture & Patterns

- Invoice rendering sits behind `src/invoices/render/index.ts`, which exports `renderInvoicePdf(invoice, locale)`. The only implementation is `pdfkit-renderer.ts`, which draws each layout with pdfkit calls.
- The 11 layouts are TypeScript modules in `src/invoices/layouts/` (`standard.ts`, `compact.ts`, `credit-note.ts`, and so on). Locale variants for `ar` and `he` set `dir: 'rtl'` and pass shaped text through the fork's `shapeBidi()` helper.
